title: Measure scientific non-inferiority of CPU, CUDA and hybrid motion correction

labels.name: track:validation
labels.description: Reference data, parity and scientific gates

body:
## Why this task exists

CPU image agreement alone does not measure whether a CUDA backend preserves recoverable cryo-EM signal. The MotionCor2 and RELION motion-correction papers evaluate CTF/high-frequency signal and reconstruction quality rather than a CPU-versus-GPU corrected-image relative RMSE of 0.001. The native CUDA and opt-in all-FFTW hybrid should be assessed against the same CPU source and data, with numerical differences retained in the report.

## Scope and pass criteria

- [ ] Write a prospective protocol for same-source CPU, native CUDA and all-FFTW hybrid outputs: source/input hashes, movie options, gain, dose, seed, artifact provenance, and numerical outcomes. Use Issue #36's full 24-movie comparison when complete; do not duplicate its GPU runs or call the two-movie result a dataset pass.
- [ ] Select feasible tutorial and independent held-out datasets. Assess CTF fit/high-frequency signal as an initial screen, followed by particle-level and independently refined half-map FSC and relative B-factor comparisons where feasible. Report what the available data cannot establish.
- [ ] Use matched particle selection, half-set assignments, masks and downstream settings for a controlled diagnostic, then a normal refinement workflow. Measure the corrected outputs before a later motion re-estimation step can mask differences.
- [ ] Define a scientifically interpretable non-inferiority margin **before** evaluating held-out results; estimate uncertainty by movie/collection unit rather than treating pixels as independent replicates. Report pass, fail or inconclusive, with no threshold chosen to make current CUDA data pass.
- [ ] Publish the protocol and pilot evidence with exact commands, hashes, time/memory and numerical gate status. Consult repository architecture guidance before code changes; keep any implementation in an isolated branch and PR.

Related: #4, #36, #58, #59, #60. Own downstream workflow/protocol only. Coordinate exclusive access to 4GPUs and the 8-logical-CPU cap; start with read-only design while the full 24-movie hybrid run is active.
